title: The Maharashtra Suraksha Dal Act, 1986.
full_text: The Maharashtra Suraksha Dal Act, 1986. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19873 Act Number: 3 Enactment Date: 1987-02-12 Act Year: 1987 Short Title: The Maharashtra Suraksha Dal Act, 1986. Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution and regulation of a Force called the Maharashtra Suraksha Dal for the better protection and security of the premises of the Government, public sector undertakings, local authorities and banks situated in the State of Maharashtra.
